sections.Profile:
The Gold Rush pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in April 1966, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game designed by Ted Zale. It features a Western gold-mining theme.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Prospecting, Single Player, Western, Backbox Gimmick, Original Theme, Mining
